title: Playground
description: The plain viewer with every option, theme token and built-in control in one panel. Show only a clade, collapse clades or weakly supported branches. Try it on trees from 6 tips to 2.4 million, or on a file of your own. The URL keeps your settings, so a view can be shared.

title: Tree explorer
description: The styled showcase of the library, an alternative to the playground: toolbars, tools, a node menu on click, show only a clade, collapse by support, ladderise, search, overview, alignment and export, built on <TreeView> and tree-ops, with a theme made only of CSS custom properties. Every tree of the playground, up to 2.4 million tips.

title: Table view
description: A table like TBrowse: one row per tip at a fixed height, the wheel scrolls rows instead of zooming, and the tree is one column among data columns (label fields, an alignment, gene location, an expression heatmap, a score), each with a header and a resize handle. The overview strip is the scrollbar. Built on the public API; its README lists what the viewer cannot do for it yet.

title: Unrooted layout spike
description: The equal-angle layout of #42, before the viewer has an unrooted view: every branch drawn on a plain canvas, with no zoom, pan or level of detail. Pick a tree, with or without branch lengths and labels. A throw-away page for deciding whether the viewer should get layout: 'unrooted'; it uses the layout from the viewer's source, not the public API.
